verdict.rationale: Inngest documents step.ai.wrap() for wrapping OpenAI, Anthropic, and Vercel AI SDK calls as durable steps with observability, plus AgentKit as a first-party framework for building agents, and a durable agent-loop pattern guide. However, coverage is limited to a handful of AI SDKs/frameworks rather than a broad first-party integration catalog spanning many model providers or agent frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex), and there's no independent evidence validating breadth or reliability of these wrappers. Missing for 10: broader provider/framework coverage beyond OpenAI/Anthropic/Vercel AI SDK, independent/hands-on validation of the step.ai wrapper integrations, and evidence of integrations with other popular agent frameworks.
